profile.headline: Senior Front-End Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Front-End Software Engineer with a love of JavaScript and interactive UI. Experienced in training and team-building, and committed to continual learning.

Specialties:
- React.js
- React Native
- JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
- Ruby, Rails, and ActiveRecord
- SQL and Presto
- Chocolates and Confections

Find me on GitHub at:
https://github.com/msgalenwhite

positions.title: Stability Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead Front-End design and development of a new internal tool used by multiple teams
- Wrote user stories and designed and built UI prototypes for multiple project teams
- Analyzed complex datasets and wrote queries to advise a team of sales and advertising professionals
- Built data pipelines and alerts that lead to early detection of serious platform-wide issues

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Investigated, built, and deployed features and fixes to production for all clients across multiple codebases
- Implemented archiving, editing, and creating new merchandising categories from database through to frontend UI
- Adapted customers’ data structure of regional store locations to satisfy changing requirements
- Authored reusable script to automate new-client database setup process
- Created script to identify invalid data on large customer production databases to unblock feature development

positions.title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Launch Academy is a 10-week, immersive programming bootcamp designed to give eager learners the background knowledge and skills necessary to add value as a junior contributor to a software engineering team.  During my time at Launch Academy I:

- Built full-stack applications using React and Rails
- Learned basic data structures
- Utilized data queries in ActiveRecord, so that my back-end was only supplying my front-end with relevant information (and no user ids!)
- Styled apps using Foundation, SCSS and CSS
- Contributed to Open Source by adding to Launch Academy's 'make_it_so' gem on Github
- Worked collaboratively using pair-programming
- Wrote Unit, Feature and Integration tests using Rspec, Capybara and Jasmine-Enzyme

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
- Continuously improved daily customer-service and efficiency in a fast-paced, high-stress environment
- Trained new employees in customer service, respect for product, and interpersonal conduct
- Found and addressed bottle-necks to quality service through employee training and one-on-one support
- Changed processes resulting in no phone complaints on the busiest day of the year (for the first time)

The Gingerbread Construction Company can be found at:
www.gingerbreadusa.com

positions.title: Pastry Cook
positions.description:

- Worked alongside experienced Chef to prepare a rotating menu of dessert selections
- Prepared and served hors d’oeuvres for private parties

- Trained fellow chocolatiers and seasonal workers in Piping and Chocolate Production
- Designed and introduced streamlined guide for decorating molded chocolate Easter Bunnies
- Responsible for large-scale ganache, caramel and ice cream production
- Assisted with pretzel and crepe-making for Oktoberfest and Bastille Day at the L. A. Burdick Restaurant

projects.title: Family Newsletter
projects.description:
My project repository can be found at: https://github.com/msgalenwhite/NewsletterApp

The Family Newsletter enables a user to start a newsletter, invite all of their family, and receive a single emailed Newsletter at the end of the month with everyone's entries. It combines React and Rails, as well as Google Maps (so newsletter members can see everyone's location clearly as markers on a map), and SendGrid and ActionMailer (for emails in production and development.)

The Family Newsletter was a chance to explore the interconnectivity of React and Rails, and to put myself up against a harsh deadline just as I would be on the job.

projects.title: Dominion Card Designer
projects.description:
My project repository can be found at: https://github.com/msgalenwhite/DominionCardDesigner

Card games often come with "make your own" blank cards - Dominion Card Designer lets you play with those unaltered blank cards, and design an online picture of what they represent. Built as a side-project to practice React, Scss, and Foundation, it does not have database capabilities to persist cards (yet.)

The Dominion Card Designer was a practice project for React and React Router. Before starting the project I had had minimal exposure to React, and no practice starting projects from a basic scaffold of Sinatra and React. I learned to use a json file as temporary storage, and to style using FlexBox, Foundation and CSS.
